comment: One case table for the ordering model (docs/design/ordering.md) on both sides: pkg/board/queue_fixture_test.go (Go) and web/src/queue.test.ts (TS) read it. A task id's first letter names its epic (A, B, C, X); an id starting with L or N is neutral. `epicOrder` is the epics' order (default A < B < C < X); `queue` is one team's queue in board order. bestGap: the gap an empty epic's first task (or an epic's block) goes in. create: tasks made one by one in their epics by the default place (Q3). moveEpic: the epic moved to the place `epicOrder` gives it, its tasks gathered (Q5). reorderInEpic: a task moved within its epic, before or after another of its tasks, over the epic's slots (Q6).
